answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a pearl of collateral before its vote counts, and influence scales with that deposit, not with the number of identities. Splitting one wallet into a thousand fake agents cannot multiply power, since the same capital is only divided. If a whisper of collusion is confirmed, the culprit's stake is slashed and its ember of credit is burned, so an attack costs real, forfeitable value rather than free identities.
